summary: The audit checks the 30 units of the minor: CSRE 100 and one Comparative Core course (CSRE 101A, 101B or 101C), each letter graded with a C- or better, and 20 units of electives from the CCSRE family with a passing grade, at most 10 of them from AFRICAAM, ASNAMST, CHILATST, JEWISHST or NATIVEAM courses (a CSRE course cross-listed there counts too). Language courses do not count, and at most one elective (5 units) may be S/NC. You check by hand petitioned courses from outside CCSRE (at most 5 units).

FSYlaumX.why: Grading: "A minimum grade of C- is required for a student to count a class towards the Core Curriculum, including the Gateway and Comparative Core." "Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units": only Additional Units may be S/NC, so the core needs a letter grade.

qjkRH6NB.why: "CSRE minors must complete the remaining units of their 30-unit minimum with elective coursework in CSRE, with the exception below. CSRE minors may count up to 10 units of coursework listed in the Department of African and African American Studies (DAAAS), Asian American Studies (ASNAMST), Chicana/o-Latina/o Studies (CHILATST), Jewish Studies (JEWISHST), and/or Native American Studies (NATIVEAM) toward their elective coursework in the CSRE minor." The 30 units are the Bulletin's program minimum; CSRE 100 and the Comparative Core course are 5 units each, so 20 remain. "Language courses do not count toward CSRE minor requirements": the Hebrew, Yiddish, Biblical Hebrew and Cherokee language courses listed in these subjects are left out of the pool. The cap also counts a CSRE course cross-listed in those subjects (CSRE 4 is also AFRICAAM 4); whether a cross-listed course is "listed in" DAAAS for the cap is not said.

limits.label: DAAAS, ASNAMST, CHILATST, JEWISHST and NATIVEAM courses

totals.label: One S/NC class (up to 5 units)
totals.why: Grading: "Additional units toward the minor require a passing grade of D- or above. Student may count 1 class with Satisfactory/No Credit (SNC) grading basis toward Additional Units." The cap is in units; one CSRE class carries at most 5.
